Mutation testing, repo side (04-mutants-docs-workflow.txt): 74 single-point mutants of the positive-control tree; 71 caught, 3 survivors. The 3 survivors (w35 YAML comment on the run line, w36 trailing blank lines, w37 comment-only edit inside the job) are deliberate false-fail controls: they change no behaviour and workflow_job_notes allows comments, so they must pass. Every requested weakening fails at least one check: -k (S04), --allow-unsupported-isolation (AT1,S04), env var step/job (S04), sysctl || true (S04,S05), guard removed (S04,S05), whole step masked (S04), continue-on-error job/step/guard (S04), jsonschema install removed (S04), checkout/setup-python SHA changed or unpinned (S04), second job (AT1,AT2,AT4,S04), permissions top-level/job (S04), pull_request trigger removed, workflow_dispatch added, matrix, extra action, if:false, name added, order swapped, tee pipe, wrong guard test, wrong sysctl value, UNSUPPORTED in a step name (all S04), validate job neutered (S04), suite/sandbox/validate.sh/DEBT.md/pages.yml edited (S03), feature-list status flipped (S03). Doc mutants: each of the four DoD count replacements left unsynced (AT2,S06), job list missing the key (AT2,S06), 'five' (AT2,S06), version/change_log not bumped or altered (S06), README paragraph removed/moved out of Machine Validation/unbackticked/flag meaning flipped (AT4,S06 or S06), schema README sole-validator line missing (AT3,S06), moved outside ## Schemas (AT3,S06), wrapped so file name and 'sole validator' split (AT3,S06), wrapped elsewhere (S06 only: AT3 is line-based and still holds), 'a validator' (AT3,S06), other file name (AT3,S06), CHANGELOG bullet missing/altered (S03,S07 / S07), phase-YAML key missing/BLOCKED/extra key/other step edited (S07). All mutation sites were verified to hit the document body, not the frontmatter summary (d14/d17/d18 were first mis-aimed at the summary by my harness and re-run with nth=last).

Mutation testing, CI-evidence side (05-ci-synthetic.txt): AT5-AT8, S10, S11 against synthetic captures, a gh shim serving canned live fixtures, real git and a local bare origin. Control and a 'real' control (a real gh run JSON, run 37967901131, relabelled as the convergent_review job) both exit 0 on all six. 39 mutants, 38 caught, 1 survivor (c27). Caught: mutation base != positive headSha (S11), diff target != negative headSha (S11), weakened job (-k) at the positive headSha (S10,S11), tampered or truncated positive log versus the live log (S10), cancelled run or cancelled sibling job or skipped job (AT5,S10), headBranch phase/014-ga-track or main (AT5), negative log without 'AssertionError: 40 != 0' or with 41 or a different failing test (AT8), negative branch not throwaway/104- (AT7,S11), negative job success (AT7), negative PR merged or still open (S11), throwaway branch still on the remote (S11), namespace-only or Landlock-only or extra-file or workflow-touching mutation (S11), wrong job's log (AT6,S10), capture differing from the live run (S10), missing job or EXIT:1 (AT5), headSha not an ancestor (AT5,S11), missing CONFORMANCE: FULL or only 'NOT FULL' or 'skipped' or a FAIL line in the positive log (AT6), --exit-status in the invocation line (AT5), differing job sets (S10), altered mutation capture (S11), a branch-absent capture with a result line (S11), non-throwaway PR headRefName (S11).

The one CI-side survivor, c27 (a NEGATIVE log that contains the FAIL line and 'AssertionError: 40 != 0' and additionally an UNSUPPORTED line), is NON-BLOCKING: it does not let a weakened enforcement pass. UNSUPPORTED is produced only when the cached isolation probe fails, in which case all five sandbox tests are skipped and the cross-trial FAIL line cannot appear in the same process; the mixed log cannot arise from a genuine run, and the contract's step-8 triage already routes an UNSUPPORTED negative log to HALT and escalate. The positive path (AT6) forbids UNSUPPORTED and skipped outright.

Structure note, not a defect: most workflow weakenings (-k, env, || true, continue-on-error, SHA, permissions, trigger) are detected ONLY by S04's exact equality with the pinned job; AT1/AT2/AT4 alone would miss them. S04 is therefore load-bearing and must stay in the Generator, Mode B and Evaluator re-run sets (it is). Equality with the contract's own pinned text is sound because the pinned job was read and exercised: required mode, no flag, jsonschema installed, unmasked guard with set -e semantics (S05 proves absent/present/write-fails), bare suite step last.

Executability (06-executability.txt, read-only gh and git only): `gh run view <id> --json headSha,headBranch,conclusion,jobs` returns compact one-line JSON with stderr empty and per-job databaseId/name/conclusion; a job with no name: reports its key (validate, e2e_bootstrap, fixtures_self_test), so AT5-AT8 and S10 bind correctly on `convergent_review`. `gh run view --job <databaseId> --log` works WITHOUT a run id, stderr empty, and two consecutive fetches are byte-identical (the S10 no-normalization premise holds); the three existing jobs' logs contain neither 'skipped' nor 'UNSUPPORTED'. A real pull_request run reports headBranch as the head ref (phase/014-103-sandbox-prereq), matching AT5's literal logic. `gh pr view` on a closed unmerged PR gives mergedAt JSON null (S11 falsy test is right). refs/pull/<n>/head survives for a closed unmerged PR and fetches into a fresh repo (S11 fallback). `git ls-remote --heads origin <absent>` exits 0 with empty output (the branch-absent shape). No remote phase/014-104* or throwaway/* branch and no PR for the feature branch exist; the four worktree paths are free. Both mutation_replacements occur exactly once in the sources and the S11 line-level replacement check accepts them. By GitHub semantics (not exercised here: it needs the real push) a draft PR still triggers pull_request under the default types and the workflow has no draft filter; the concurrency group is per ref (refs/pull/<n>/merge) so the feature PR and the throwaway PR do not cancel each other.

Non-blocking executability gaps: (a) the contract does not pin how the Orchestrator obtains <run-id> after `gh pr create` (any of `gh run list --branch ... --event pull_request --json databaseId,headSha`, or `gh pr checks`, works; AT5/S10 then verify the result, so a wrong id fails closed). (b) GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 is optional; stderr was empty in every probe. (c) `gh pr create` and the throwaway push are real remote writes and remain Orchestrator-only; nothing here performed them.

R1 (hosted-runner capability) is correctly classified as CAPABILITY and escalated, not an implementation attempt. Reading the adapter: the sandbox script execs the adapter under the toolcache python3 BEFORE Landlock, and after the restriction execv's the trusted runner whose shebang is `#!/usr/bin/env python3`; env's PATH search skips the EACCES toolcache entry and can fall through to /usr/bin/python3 (allowlisted), so the predicted toolcache failure may well not materialize. Unverifiable locally: this workstation's AppArmor key is 1, so no capable-host branch can be exercised here. Only the real CI run can prove AT5/AT6/AT7/AT8; this review claims none of it.

Documentation sync: no other shipped document states the compliance.yml job count (git grep of the pinned-text scan at the implemented tree finds only the DoD sentences the contract replaces, NIP-0003's and ROADMAP's forward references to 'four'/'five' which are explicitly deferred, and tools/README.md's fixtures_self_test sentence which names three jobs by role, not by count). .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md's Definition-of-Done checklist does not list the new suite, but the contract's non-goal 1 excludes the PR template and the feature text does not require it; recorded as drift for the 102 open-debt roll, not a defect.

Testability (07-testability.txt): all 21 commands were scanned statically: no network (S10/S11 and AT5-AT8 only perform read-only gh and git reads at Evaluator re-run time), no `|| true` or tee, no wall clock; S05 is flagged only because it names a shim called sudo and the guard text, and never executes either on the host. The fast set (AT1-AT4, S01, S03-S07) passed three consecutive times with identical results in under 0.2 s each; the slow set passed repeatedly with no flake (AT9 ~10.7 s, AT10 ~24-26 s, S08 8.5-11.7 s, S09 ~10.8 s). Never run AT9, AT10, S08, S09 concurrently (I ran everything sequentially).

Host safety: no sudo, no sysctl, no AppArmor change, no git push, no PR, no gh write, no rerun. All experiments ran in scratch clones under the scratchpad (git clone, no worktrees registered in the repo). The contract and every tracked file other than this verdict and the new evidence directory are untouched; new files are under the S03-allowlisted prefixes .agent/qa/104 and .agent/evidence/104-qa-.

final_verdict.summary: APPROVED at contract revision 3 (104-contract attempt 3/3; no further revision needed). AT1-AT10 are byte-identical to the feature list at <A>; every base state reproduces; a contract-faithful implementation (including a full Generator-attempt simulation with S02, before and after the commit) turns AT1-AT4, AT9, AT10, S01, S03-S09 green; 113 single-point mutants were injected and 109 caught (4 survivors: 3 semantic-neutral false-fail controls and 1 non-blocking mixed-log case, no weakened enforcement passes undetected); the CI choreography is executable as written (gh and git shapes verified read-only against the real remote, S10/S11 verified against synthetic and real-shape captures).
